package.name: picknik_009_ur5e_vacuum_config
package.description: UR5e 009 hardware config with the Robotiq EPick suction gripper. Based on the gripper-neutral picknik_009_ur5e_hw_config; adds the EPick controllers, the EPick seal relay and the suction-only Objectives (the shelf_stocking adapters/epick library). See design_docs/end_effector_variants.md.
